UNCONTESTED CALENDAR OF NOV-15-2018, NOTICE OF DEFAULT JUDGMENT PROVE-UP HEARING AS TO DEFENDANT -GRANTED. PROPOSED JUDGMENT WAS SUBMITTED TO AND SIGNED BY THE COURT. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY MITCH L. LYON, CSR #6840. TELEPHONE: 415-551-3703. JUDGE: ERIC R. FLEMING. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. (D514).

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST A CALIFORNIA BANKING CORPORATION DOING BUSINESS THROUGH ITS CLAAS FINANCIAL SERVICES DIVISION RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SCHROEDER, CHRIS AN INDIVIDUAL ALSO KNOWN AS CHRISTOPHER SCHROEDER AND AS CHRIS E. SCHROEDER $55,936.09 PRINCIPAL, $2,825.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $527.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $59,288.59, SEE SCANNED DOC - ADDITIONALLY, PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST, A CALIFORNIA CORPORATION, DOING BUSINESS THROUGH ITS CLAAS FINANCIAL SERVICES DIVISION, IS TO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHRIS SCHROEDER, AN INDIVIDUAL, A/K/A CHRISTOPHER SCHROEDER AND AS CHRIS E. SCHROEDER, POSSESSION OF THE PERSONAL PROPERTY DESCRIBED ON ATTACHMENT 1 OF THE JUDGMENT. IF PLAINTIFF OBTAINS POSSESSION OF THE DESCRIBED PROPERTY AND SELLS IT A SALE, PLAINTIFF SHALL APPLY THE PROCEEDS FROM ANY SUCH SALE, NET OF ANY SALE AND RECOVERY EXPENSES, TO REDUCE THE AMOUNT OWED BY DEFENDANT CHRIS SCHROEDER, AN INDIVIDUAL, A/K/A CHRISTOPHER SCHROEDER AND AS CHRIS E. SCHROEDER, UNDER THIS JUDGMENT.
